title: Insect Explorer ABC
hook: One trait starts the guess; several traits build the name.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: 3D preschool insect explorer storybook, friendly field-guide aesthetic, bright garden palette, isolated specimens

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child building cautious field identifications from several traits
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written field marks with uncertainty and safety
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: field-mark cue -> recall beat -> target -> sketch/point gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a tiny parade snare-brush tap plus bright marimba step after the target.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a tiny parade snare-brush tap plus bright marimba step after the target
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Insect Explorer a field-identification protocol: first observe body shape, leg count, antennae, wings and behavior, then identify cautiously; uncertain project mapping terms stay labeled rather than overclaimed.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child builds a field-note ID from multiple traits instead of marching or guessing from color.
imageMotifs: yellow butterfly color warning against over-ID
